batch_report.accounting_scope: Recorded episode costs include failed and incomplete work. Missing fields and unattached physics are explicit; totals may be partial. Elapsed seconds are sums across episodes, not batch wall time.
batch_report.interpretation: Outcome counts cover only validated completed episodes; all other planned jobs remain in statuses. A missing process record does not prove a process is live. This report makes no causal or safety guarantee.

interpretation: Three episodes first violate container support before lid placement while the target is held: one completes unsafely and two remain unsafe unfinished. The other five are safe unfinished. None of the three violating trials records lid placement. Three safe-unfinished trials record lid placement but never hold the target container. None completes safely. This establishes observed premature-transition cases in three engineering scenes, not that a guard can recover safe completion. No-observed-violation unfinished outcomes do not discharge an unmet strong-until prerequisite.

visual_inspection.observation: Inspected initial approach, grasp vicinity, and final transport. The final frame shows the roaster raised with exposed contents. Predicate timing and target holding come from the validated monitor and goal records, not a visual estimate.
